item.title: More than 20 million households will get £100 energy payment next year
item.body: Households in council tax bands A–D are due to receive the £100 payment from the government in their bank accounts next year. A date for the payment has been revealed.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💷 More than 20 million households will get £100 energy payment next year

Households in council tax bands A–D are due to receive the £100 payment from the government in their bank accounts next year. A date for the payment has been revealed.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 24 November, 21:20

#BreakingNews #EnergyPayment #UKHouseholds
